name: Park Jae-Hyun
bio:
Park Jae-Hyun's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for precision engineering. Growing up in Seoul, he spent hours tinkering with model cars and dismantling electronics, driven by an insatiable curiosity for how things worked. This early interest led him to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering, where he excelled in courses related to materials science and manufacturing processes.

After graduating, Park landed a role at a local automotive firm, but his passion for racing never waned. He spent his weekends volunteering at a small, independent racing team, learning the ropes of fabrication and vehicle maintenance. His dedication and meticulous approach soon caught the attention of Triple Eight Race Engineering, who offered him a position as a fabricator. Park thrives on the challenges of crafting bespoke components for high-performance vehicles, always striving for perfection and pushing the boundaries of what's possible. His ability to visualize complex designs and translate them into tangible, race-winning parts is what sets him apart.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: A man of average height, Park has a focused expression and a build honed from years of hands-on work.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical sketches and design ideas.
Has a habit of meticulously cleaning his workspace, even when under pressure.
Often hums quietly while working, seemingly lost in concentration.
